Maria (CSM): Heads up — noticed account 'AtriaHealth' dropped ~60% API usage overnight after their ML lead left. Procurement pinged us about 'speed/cost comparisons' with a vendor pilot. Can we triage quickly? :eyes:
Devon (CS Ops): Thanks Maria. Do we have timeframe on renewal?
Maria (CSM): Renewal in 6 weeks. Champion left last week; new PM hasn't replied to our enablement invites. They still have Dedicated trial capacity but not using it.
Raj (Solutions Eng): Quick checks — can someone run a call to validate key and endpoint? Sometimes onboarding scripts get blocked by IP allowlist. Example curl to test token:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ATRIA_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage | jq '.'
```
Devon (CS Ops): Just ran that against their token — returning 403 from our edge (invalid key) and a small spike of 429s earlier. Oncall Bot reported a transient gateway failure at 02:14 UTC.
Oncall Bot: [automated] 02:14 UTC — gateway timeout spikes (region: us-east-1). Incident cleared at 02:23 UTC. Affected requests: ~1.2k.
Ellie (AE): Procurement said competitor demo emphasized lower per-token cost + a managed plugin that reduces infra ops. If it's just an API key/allowlist issue we can win this back fast. Suggest a focused enablement session + 1-week trial extension of Dedicated with a benchmark doc (latency/cost).
Raj (Solutions Eng): I'll prepare a minimal troubleshooting checklist and a quick playbook for them: 1) confirm token & allowlist 2) run usage test (curl above) 3) enable KV cache option on the trial and re-run. I'll paste the checklist here later.
Devon (CS Ops): Action items: @Raj produce checklist (ETA: today EOD), @Maria schedule enablement walk-through for Mon AM, @Ellie offer 1-week Dedicated extension + performance comparison doc. I'll ask infra to confirm there are no residual throttles on their tenant.
Maria (CSM): I'll ping their PM and copy their procurement. If no reply by EOD I'll escalate to the executive sponsor and offer a calendar slot.
Ellie (AE): I'll draft the benchmark sheet — will add cost delta and typical latency numbers (embedding vs gen).
Raj (Solutions Eng): Draft checklist: ``1) Validate token 2) Confirm IP allowlist 3) Run curl usage test 4) Confirm model variant & seq_len 5) Enable KV cache & retry 6) Share logs if 403 persists`` — will refine and post.
Devon (CS Ops): Noting: if we extend Dedicated, flag to billing so they don't auto-invoice for next cycle.
Maria (CSM): Thanks. Plan sounds good. Will update thread after PM reply. :thumbsup:
